entries.back_en: Wait... Thou also art one of the Eternal...?
entries.note: 'Eternos' is acceptable rendering of 'The Endless'; archaic tone preserved.

entries.back_en: No matter! No one, not even if he were brother to my master, may be allowed to enter!
entries.note: Typo 'irmaio' should be 'irmão'; otherwise meaning preserved.
'Quem vai ali' is a literal mistranslation; idiom should be 'Quem vem lá!?' or 'Quem está aí!?'
